commit.message:
Revert "fix(ci): add contents:write permission and proper GitHub release publishing"

This reverts commit ab9cbc2d2c85731ab3734e0075c3f1936fd59e3a.

verification.payload:
tree 37af34cd6d30b1439b67febf29e639ae50fa5252
parent ab9cbc2d2c85731ab3734e0075c3f1936fd59e3a
author Mark Jerwin <ping@jrwnnnn.me> 1777109313 +0800
committer Mark Jerwin <ping@jrwnnnn.me> 1777109313 +0800

Revert "fix(ci): add contents:write permission and proper GitHub release publishing"

This reverts commit ab9cbc2d2c85731ab3734e0075c3f1936fd59e3a.

files.patch:
@@ -50,7 +50,7 @@ jobs:
     needs: [typecheck, codeql]
     runs-on: windows-latest
     permissions:
-      contents: write
+      contents: read
     steps:
       - uses: actions/checkout@v4
       - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
@@ -62,11 +62,12 @@ jobs:
         run: npm ci
 
       - name: Build
-        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
         run: npm run build
-
-      - name: Build and release
-        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
-        run: npm run release
         env:
           GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
+
+      - name: Upload Artifact
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: re-color
+          path: release/
